warnings: Warnings For external use only Do not use • if you have open wounds in or near the eyes, and get medical help right away • if solution changes color or becomes cloudy When using this product • remove contact lenses before using • do not touch tip of container to any surface to avoid contamination • replace cap after use Stop use and ask a doctor if • you experience eye pain, changes in vision, continued redness or irritation of the eye • condition worsens or persists Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
